title: PRO-Step：面向检索增强生成的步骤级过程奖励优化
summary: PRO-Step 提出一种用于检索增强生成（RAG）的步骤级过程奖励优化方法。它训练生成式过程奖励模型（PRM）同时评估逻辑有效性和证据基础，利用PRM引导的值树搜索构建偏好对，并通过步骤级直接偏好优化（DPO）优化策略，以解决多跳推理中的错误传播和虚假成功问题。在五个基准上取得最佳平均EM和F1。
summary_en: PRO-Step introduces a step-level process reward optimization method for RAG. It trains a generative PRM to evaluate both logical validity and evidential grounding, uses PRM-guided value tree search to construct preference pairs, and optimizes the policy via step-level DPO, addressing error propagation and spurious successes in multi-hop reasoning. Achieves best average EM and F1 across five benchmarks.
